# Project: Pat Lib Online
> LLM-first web design and pattern library with Prompt Mode and Code Mode outputs.

## Start Here

- Root: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/`
- LLM index page: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/llm`
- Machine index endpoint: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/api/llm/index`
- Sitemap: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/sitemap.xml`

## Retrieval Modes

### Prompt Mode
Use when the LLM should generate or refine prompts for an AI coder.

1. Read `/api/llm/playbooks` and select an industry playbook.
2. Read `/api/llm/playbooks/[slug]` for `modes.prompt`.
3. Pull pattern prompt examples from `/api/llm/patterns/[id]`.
4. Pull guardrails from `/api/llm/references/[id]` (`core-rules`, `pattern-select`, `prompt-vocabulary`).

### Code Mode
Use when the LLM is the coder and should integrate components directly.

1. Read `/api/llm/patterns` and choose required patterns.
2. Read `/api/llm/patterns/[id]` for `modes.code.implementation`.
3. Pull implementation/CSS constraints from `/api/llm/references/[id]` (`implementation-blocks`, `css-bridge`).
4. Optionally use `/api/llm/playbooks/[slug]` for integration order.

## Human Navigation

- `/library`: pattern catalog with Prompt vs Code tabs
- `/playbooks`: industry-specific integration packs (dentist, restaurant, contractor)
- `/reference`: indexed guidance from `/lib-files`

## API Endpoints

- `/api/llm/index`
- `/api/llm/patterns`
- `/api/llm/patterns/[id]`
- `/api/llm/playbooks`
- `/api/llm/playbooks/[slug]`
- `/api/llm/references`
- `/api/llm/references/[id]`

## Data Notes

- Pattern IDs are stable (example: `1.4`, `10.2`).
- `modes.prompt` contains prompt-ready guidance.
- `modes.code` contains code-ready integration content.
